The '''Rainos Cluster''' was a strategic location in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] placed a [[Imperial supply depot (Rainos Cluster)|''Baas''-class space station]] there, to serve as a deep-space supply depot.<ref name="Meltdown" />
